USAGE:
    bee [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    init            Configure bee: store the single Mongo connection everything 
                    else is pulled from                                         
    remember        Persistent memory (decisions/errors/learnings). Bare text   
                    saves; 'context/search/stats/history' query                 
    ask             Ask the configured model (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Anthropic). Reads 
                    stdin if no prompt — an AI-to-AI access point               
    soul            SOUL protocol — bee's persona/identity. Bare shows the      
                    active soul; list/use/add/show/claim/remove                 
    skill           Query a skill-bridge (domain skills) over MCP.              
                    Config-driven:                                              
                    search/list/get/resolve/categories/suggest/tools            
    howto           Pattern/how-to store (Mongo-backed). Bare text searches;    
                    get/add/list/rm manage your conventions                     
    hook            Steer the AI: emit identity + rules + memory for agent      
                    hooks; manage behavioral rules                              
    compact         Which memories are costing recall rather than adding to it. 
                    Reports only                                                
    lint <paths>    What this project expects of these files — ask BEFORE       
                    writing, not at review (--json)                             
    handover        The state of play for whoever picks the work up next        
                    (--since, --json)                                           
    budget          What bee costs the agent's context per turn, broken down by 
                    component                                                   
    worker          Background maintenance: work that must not happen on the way

DESCRIPTION:
Persistent memory (decisions/errors/learnings). Bare text saves; 
'context/search/stats/history' query

USAGE:
    bee remember [action] [content] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [action]     A verb (context/search/stats/history) or the content to save
    [content]    Content when the first arg is a verb like 'search'          

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help            Prints help information                               
    -t, --type            decision | error | learning | pattern (default:       
                          learning)                                             
        --reason                                                                
        --alternative     An option considered and rejected, as "option: why    
                          not". Repeatable                                      
        --solution                                                              
        --prevention                                                            
        --category                                                              
        --tags            Comma-separated tags                                  
        --session                                                               
        --json            Emit a stable machine-readable shape instead of a     
                          table                                                 
        --before          Only memories learned before this: 7d, 24h, or a date 
                          like 2026-08-01                                       
        --agent                                                                 
        --all-projects                                                          
        --semantic        Rank by embedding (cosine) similarity instead of token
                          match                                                 
        --since           History window, e.g. 7d, 24h, 30m                     
        --limit

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Ask the configured model (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Anthropic). Reads stdin if no prompt —
an AI-to-AI access point

USAGE:
    bee ask [prompt] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [prompt]    The question. If omitted, bee reads the prompt from stdin

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help           Prints help information                                
        --provider       Override provider: deepseek | openai | anthropic       
    -m, --model          Override the model id                                  
    -s, --system         Optional system prompt (added on top of the active     
                         soul)                                                  
        --soul           Use a specific persona for this call instead of the    
                         active one                                             
        --no-soul        Ignore the active persona for this call                
        --tools          Let the model call bee's tools (memory/skill/config).  
                         Read tools only, unless --allow-write                  
        --allow-write    Permit write/sensitive tools (memory_save, config_get).
                         Default: denied by the gate                            
        --raw            Print only the answer (no header). Default when stdout 
                         is piped

                          --restore
